# Test vectors (generated - do not edit)

Generated by `golden/make_vectors.py` from `golden/golden.py` (seed 20261107). SIMULATED data.
Every expected column is computed by a golden-model function; the assumptions behind those
functions are A1-A21 at the top of `golden/golden.py`.

## Format

- One header line of column names, then one row per line. Comma separated, `\n` line endings.
- Every value is lowercase hex, zero-padded to ceil(bits / 4) digits, no `0x` prefix.
- Signed columns are two's complement at the stated bit width (e.g. 18-bit `delta_adj` = -1 -> `3ffff`).
  Sign-extend from that width in the testbench.
- Array columns are written `name0 .. name7` (or `.. name15`), index 0 first.

Reading a file in SystemVerilog (Questa):

```systemverilog
int fd = $fopen("docs/vectors/reprice.csv", "r");
string hdr; void'($fgets(hdr, fd));            // skip the header line
while (!$feof(fd)) begin
  if ($fscanf(fd, "%h,%h,%h,%h,%h,%h,%h,%h,%h,%h,%h\n",
              kind, s, s_ref, ds, theo0, dadj, gam, p1, g1, p2, theo_new) != 11) break;
  // drive inputs, compare outputs
end
```

Declare each variable at least as wide as its column (signed columns: declare `logic signed [N-1:0]`
at the column width so `%h` fills the two's complement pattern directly).

## parser.csv - 128-bit message words and parsed fields

A **stream**: feed rows in file order into one parser that starts from reset. Expected flags depend on the words before them (golden `SeqTracker`, A12). Fields are extracted even when the CRC is bad. The stream starts at seq 65,400 so it wraps naturally.

Rows: 600. Columns: 17.

| Column | Bits | Signed | Hex digits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | 4 | no | 1 | generator label, see table below |
| `word` | 128 | no | 32 | message word, bit 127 first (MSB) |
| `type` | 8 | no | 2 | bits 127..120 |
| `seq` | 16 | no | 4 | bits 119..104 |
| `ts_us` | 32 | no | 8 | bits 103..72 |
| `id` | 4 | no | 1 | bits 71..68 |
| `bid` | 18 | no | 5 | bits 67..50 (fill price in a fill report) |
| `ask` | 18 | no | 5 | bits 49..32 (filled quantity in a fill report) |
| `bid_size` | 12 | no | 3 | bits 31..20 |
| `ask_size` | 12 | no | 3 | bits 19..8 |
| `crc8` | 8 | no | 2 | bits 7..0 as received |
| `crc_calc` | 8 | no | 2 | CRC-8 computed over bits 127..8 |
| `crc_ok` | 1 | no | 1 | crc_calc == crc8 |
| `first` | 1 | no | 1 | first CRC-good word since reset (sets the reference, no seq check) |
| `seq_gap` | 1 | no | 1 | seq != last + 1 and != last (CRC-good words only) |
| `seq_dup` | 1 | no | 1 | seq == last (CRC-good words only) |
| `last_seq` | 16 | no | 4 | parser reference seq after this word (0 before the first good word) |

`kind` codes:

| kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | valid, in order |
| 1 | bad CRC: one payload bit flipped after the CRC was computed |
| 2 | bad CRC: CRC byte wrong |
| 3 | sequence gap forward |
| 4 | duplicate (exact repeat of the last good word) |
| 5 | sequence goes backwards (reported as a gap) |
| 6 | valid word across the 65,535 -> 0 wrap |

## microprice.csv - size-weighted microprice, Q4 cents

Independent rows. Expected value is golden `microprice_q4(bid, ask, bid_size, ask_size, RECIP)` with recip[t] = round(2^20 / t), t = 1..8191 (13-bit address, 20-bit entries, recip[1] saturated to 2^20 - 1; golden A10b). Sizes are 12-bit message fields, so the total is at most 8,190 and no halving ever happens. Spreads are 0..20 cents (R05 range); both sizes 0 is never generated (R05 rejects it).

Rows: 4759. Columns: 6.

| Column | Bits | Signed | Hex digits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | 4 | no | 1 | generator label |
| `bid` | 18 | no | 5 | bid, cents |
| `ask` | 18 | no | 5 | ask, cents (>= bid) |
| `bid_size` | 12 | no | 3 | bid size |
| `ask_size` | 12 | no | 3 | ask size |
| `mp_q4` | 24 | no | 6 | expected microprice, cents with 4 fraction bits |

`kind` codes:

| kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | random, bid_size + ask_size <= 4,095 |
| 1 | bid_size + ask_size > 4,095 (upper half of the 13-bit recip ROM) |
| 2 | edge: one side 0, zero spread, size 4,095 both sides, top of the 18-bit range, total 1 (saturated recip) |
| 3 | large totals near 4,095 and 8,190 (where the old 16-bit recip error was worst) |

## trigger.csv - order selection from 16 edges

Independent rows. Expected = golden `trigger()` (A13-A15). Edge index e = 2*contract + side (side 0 buy at ask, 1 sell at bid). An edge fires when edge > 384, quote_ok[c] = 1, lockout[e] = 0 and the displayed size on that side > 0; size = min(displayed, edge cap, 10, room), room = 20 - pos (buy) or 20 + pos (sell), floored at 0; size-0 candidates are dropped. At most 2 orders, highest edge first, ties to the lowest e. Unused order slots are all zero.

Rows: 2021. Columns: 81.

## gate.csv - risk gate: full state + one order -> reason code

Independent rows (pure combinational check; latching, token refill and arming are outside). Expected = golden `gate_eval(state, order)` (A16-A21). Directed rows are asserted by the generator: single-violation rows fail exactly `target`, boundary pass rows fail nothing, two-at-once rows fail exactly {target, target2}. R10's limit (0.03 * 2^23 * 100) is not an integer, so its pair is the largest passing and smallest failing integer sum. R09/R11/R13/R14/R01/R02/R04/R05/R06/R07/R08/R12 pairs hit the limit exactly.
